in_hindi.name: विश्वामित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who alleviates all sorrows, one who is a mother to all

in_tamil.name: விஷ்வாமித்ர
in_tamil.meaning: இடம் கோலம் பிறப்புவான், அரியர் குலம் ஆகவான்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is the root of all places, One who is the king of noblemen

in_telugu.name: విశ్వమిట్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is a friend of all, One who is the lord of all beings

in_marathi.name: Vishvamitra

in_bengali.name: Vishvamitra
